data.name: The Labyrinth
data.detailed_description:
It has been waiting for ten years.

A man claimed to have escaped a labyrinth that shouldn't exist. No one believed him — he was declared insane and locked away. Now it's your turn to step inside. Alone, or with those you trust.

The Labyrinth is a first-person co-op horror game where up to 6 players must survive, help one another, and find the way out — while something hunts you in the dark.

Survive Together

Co-op for up to 6 players — online with friends, in split-screen, or solo with bots.

Proximity voice chat — talk to whoever's nearby. But be careful: noise draws out what lives here.

Pick your allies back up — when a friend goes down, you have little time to get them back on their feet before it's too late.

The Darkness Is Alive

Your flashlight is everything — the creatures hide in the pitch black and only reveal themselves in the light. But the light also gives away where you are.

The labyrinth shifts — corridors seal shut behind you. The path you memorized may not exist anymore.

They hear you — running, talking, breathing too close. Silence is a weapon.

Activate the altars to unlock the exit gate... but every altar you awaken makes the night more dangerous.

Uncover the Truth

Scattered through the labyrinth are fragments left behind by those who came before you. Piece together the map — and the story — to understand what really happened here.

Can you find the way out before the labyrinth finds you?

data.short_description: Co-op first-person horror for up to 6 players. Explore a living maze that reshapes itself, activate altars to unlock the exit, and revive your allies before it's too late. Use your flashlight to see the creatures, but light and noise draw whatever hunts you in the dark.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-compatible GPU, 2 GB VRAM (NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4000 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur (64-bit)
  • Processor: Apple M1 / Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU / Metal-capable GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4000 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Apple Silicon and 64-bit Intel supported.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 / SteamOS 3.0 (64-bit) or compatible
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-capable GPU, 2 GB VRAM (GTX 1050 / RX 560 / Steam Deck APU)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4000 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan drivers (Mesa). Runs on Steam Deck.

content_descriptors.notes: This game is a horror experience intended for mature audiences. It contains scenes of intense fear and tension — including monsters that hunt the players, jump scares, and dark, disturbing environments — as well as themes of death and being pursued. It may not be suitable for all ages.
